# CHIXIANG MOTOR — Full Technical Specification & Product Cross-Reference (/llms-full.txt)

> Official B2B engineering & procurement reference for CHIXIANG MOTOR (Chongqing Chixiang Motorcycle Manufacturing Co., Ltd.), Chongqing, China.

## 1. Company Identity, Factory Address & Quality Standards
- Brand: CHIXIANG MOTOR
- Legal Entity: Chongqing Chixiang Motorcycle Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (重庆驰翔摩托车制造有限公司)
- Factory Address: No. 1-2, Building 7, No. 1000 Gaoteng Avenue, Hangu Town, Jiulongpo District, Chongqing, China
- Industry Experience: Since 2003 (Company registered in 2007)
- Site & Capacity: 15,000 m² manufacturing facility · 10,000+ engines/month capacity
- Quality Control: 100% pre-shipment hot and cold bench testing · Two testing laboratories with eddy-current dynamometers & exhaust gas analyzers · Incoming metallurgical/hardness checks
- Certifications: ISO 9001 quality management system; CCC certification available for applicable engine models
- Contact: Tel / WhatsApp +86 19008225410 · Email chixiangmotor@163.com
- Official Channels: https://chixiangmotor.com/ · https://www.youtube.com/@chixiangmotor · https://www.linkedin.com/company/chixiang-motor/ · https://shop7p518ep539950.1688.com/

## 2. Wholesale Export Terms
- Standard MOQ: 50 Units (Mixed Models Supported across CG, CB, Horizontal, Water-Cooled, and Bajaj/TVS replacement lines)
- Lead Time: ~10 Working Days for standard configurations after order confirmation
- Export Term: FOB Guangzhou (Other Major Chinese Ports Available by Arrangement)
- Warranty: 60 Days After Destination Port Arrival (verified manufacturing/assembly defects covered with free replacement parts shipped in the next container)
- Export Execution: Export documentation and logistics are executed through Chixiang's designated export division.

## 5. HW Water (Hanwei) Heavy-Duty Spare Parts Catalog (https://chixiangmotor.com/en/engine-parts/hw-series)
- Platform Coverage: HW200 (197 ml, 63.5×62.2 mm), HW250 (249 ml, 70×64 mm), HW300 (300 ml, 74×64 mm), HW350 (300.3 ml, 76×66.2 mm).
- Engineering Commonality: ~80% of core components across HW250 & HW300 platforms (crankcases, 20-roller clutches, 5-speed transmission shafts, water pumps, high-output DC magnetos, and fastener kits) are interchangeable to reduce distributor inventory capital; cylinders, pistons, and crankshafts are matched by displacement (verify HW200/HW350 per engine code).
- Pinned Category & 8 Assemblies: Leads with Factory-Matched Service Kits (Top-End Cylinder & Piston Kit, Cylinder Head & Valve Kit, Full Overhaul Gasket & Seal Kit, Heavy-Duty Clutch & Transmission Kit—factory-matched to CHIXIANG HW-series assembly specifications) across 8 Core Assembly Groups (Cylinder Head & Valve Train with Cylinder Head Assembly distinct from Cylinder Head Cover, Cylinder & Piston Kit, Crankshaft & Crankcase, Clutch Assembly, Transmission Shafts & Gears, Water Pump & Cooling System, Starting & Electrical System, Gasket/Seal & Fastener Kits).
- Consolidation Terms: Parts consolidate with 50-unit+ complete-engine orders or are quoted per BOM (~10 working days regular lead time, FOB Guangzhou, 60-day warranty after destination port arrival).
- Technical Buyer Guide (CG250SB vs HW250 vs HW300 & ~80% Parts Commonality): https://chixiangmotor.com/en/hw250-hw300-vs-cg250-water-cooled-cargo-tricycle-engine
- Technical Buyer Guide (Bajaj Boxer/RE & TVS HLX/King OEM Fitment Checklist & Mixed Container Sourcing): https://chixiangmotor.com/en/bajaj-tvs-replacement-engine-fitment-checklist
- Technical Buyer Guide (Export Packaging Dimensions, Standard Packing Scope & MOQ 50 Mixed-Order Guide): https://chixiangmotor.com/en/motorcycle-engine-export-packaging-moq-50-mixed-loading-guide
- Technical Buyer Guide (110cc–150cc Horizontal CX Engines, YX140/W150-2 Alignment & Internal Oil Circuit): https://chixiangmotor.com/en/horizontal-motorcycle-engine-110cc-150cc-selection-guide
